cover: Taking over a codebase that still works

slides.title: Can it be rebuilt the same way twice?
slides.body: No keys to the live system left in the code, and a publish anyone can repeat. Fix this before anyone adds a feature.

slides.title: Can you name the reason for each change?
slides.body: Search engines that can't read the pages, a framework leaving support, editors waiting on a developer.

slides.title: Does the old version stay running?
slides.body: Keep the old API up and frozen, and remove nothing from it to make the new one work.

slides.title: Is rollback one setting?
slides.body: Pointing the site back at the old system should take one setting.

slides.title: Does the move copy, never delete?
slides.body: It should be safe to re-run, with the old data kept in place for a month after the switch.

slides.title: Have you seen a deploy and a rollback?
slides.body: Ask the incoming team to demonstrate both before agreeing on new features.
